description: This file defines the registration page component for a Remix.run web application, including server-side loader and action functions for user registration and client-side React component rendering the registration form.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Loader function that redirects authenticated users away from registration page.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles registration form submission; creates a new user and redirects on success or shows error message.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: React component rendering registration form UI.
